summary: This video breaks down top-performing team compositions and player leaderboards from the Chinese server for Phase 2 of the Season 8 endgame boss Mechtork. Neff Gaming reviews leaderboard setups achieving up to 12 billion total score across multiple team runs. Toxin teams led by Loter prove to be the top damage dealers, reaching over 4.4 billion damage in a single run. Shadow and Aura teams also show high potential exceeding 1.7 to 1.9 billion per run depending on Inspiration levels and key hero inclusions like Saverio.

meta_changes: Mechtork returns as the Season 8 endgame boss in Phase 2 on the CN server.
Toxin element dominates total damage contribution on multi-team endgame boss runs.
tips: Prioritize Enlightenment stats and artifacts on Toxin hero setups like Serpentemis to maximize boss damage.
Stack multiple attack-boosting artifacts across support heroes in Shadow compositions to maximize main DPS output.
Debuff-focused strategies enhance damage against Mechtork summons.
